headers.//: Files in public/ are served under their own names, so Vercel cannot content-hash them and defaults to `max-age=0, must-revalidate` — meaning every repeat visitor re-validates all 20 clips before the backdrop appears. These are write-once assets: a changed clip gets a new filename in backgroundVideos.ts, so caching them immutably for a year is safe and makes the second visit instant.
Same reasoning for the logo and other static imagery in public/.
